summary: Backend-only live regression sweep for Section 15 batch (hard per-tool-call cap, input normalizer, regression-backlog cron). Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_section15_batch_live_2026_09_22.py with 7 live end-to-end tests against the preview backend using test@aurem.dev. All 7 passed. Confirmed: (a) input normalizer accepts curly quotes / em-dash / ellipsis / foreign scripts / emoji without 500 or mangling; empty prompt returns 400/422 (not 500); ~15k char prompt handled without 500; (b) admin self-bugs list endpoint /api/aurem-dev/admin/self-bugs/list reachable & returns valid JSON as admin; (c) regression-backlog cron registers cleanly at startup ('🔁 regression-backlog scan cron enabled (every 86400s ≈ 1.0 days)' repeatedly seen in backend logs after each hot-reload); (d) normal chat/send flow works end-to-end with real LLM (OpenRouter/DeepSeek path), no orchestrator exceptions during test run; (e) both scaling-plan and repo-write-access investigation docs exist under /app/memory/. Hard per-tool-call cap could not be forced live (LLM decides tool calls) — verified only via non-regression of normal multi-tool chat + review of orchestrator log lines (R10_TIMING sequences complete cleanly, no hangs). Main agent's unit tests (test_hard_per_tool_call_cap_2026_09.py, test_input_normalizer_2026_09.py, test_regression_backlog_cron_2026_09.py) trusted per request scope.

minor.issue: Whitespace-only prompt ('   \n\t  ') is accepted (200) and routed to intent-gateway-casual as if it were a real message, rather than being rejected the way empty prompt is (422). Not a regression from this batch, but potentially worth aligning with empty-prompt behavior for consistency in the new normalizer/validator layer.

action_items: OPTIONAL: decide whether whitespace-only prompts should 422 like empty prompts do, or continue routing to casual reply — current behavior is inconsistent but harmless.
critical_code_review_comments: services/regression_backlog_cron.py cron logs 'regression-backlog scan cron enabled' on every hot-reload (seen 7+ times in current backend.err.log window). Consider guarding the log or startup-hook registration so hot-reload doesn't spam it — cosmetic only, not a functional bug.

backend/tests/conftest.py imports `services.retry_guard` without adjusting sys.path, so tests only work when pytest is invoked from /app/backend (fails with ModuleNotFoundError from /app root). Consider adding a conftest at repo root with sys.path insertion, or documenting `cwd=/app/backend` for CI.
